title: Quiet ripples
description: Concentric pulses give a simple focal point a sense of presence.
useCase: Suggest discovery or connection in an illustration. Pair actual loading or connection status with text.
interaction: Play to watch the rings expand
reducedMotion: The rings remain on a representative static frame.
limitations: This is a decorative ambient pulse, not a click-position ripple or progress indicator.
look: Near-black olive-tinted field with seven faint concentric hairline rings fading toward the bottom around a small dark green-grey disc with a pulse-line icon.
motion: Seven concentric rings breathe in a continuous loop, each scaling to 1.075 and back over 3.5 s with ease-in-out, staggered outward by 0.13 s; a text button pauses them.
adapt: The pulse is the `mg-quiet-ripple` keyframe (scale 1 to 1.075, 3.5 s ease-in-out) on each `mg-quiet-ring`; tune ring count, the `size` step, the 0.13 s `animationDelay` and per-ring opacity. Replace the centre disc's pulse-line SVG with your icon.
